review_notes: I read the whole file and checked its Mathlib dependencies. The proofs use public lemmas and definitions. These are IsLocallyConstant.iff_eventually_eq, apply_eq_of_preconnectedSpace, Path.segment_apply, AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, and IsRCLikeNormedField.rclike. I found no use of auto-generated names, private declarations, or long rewrite chains. The `let := Subtype.preconnectedSpace hs` and `let := IsRCLikeNormedField.rclike K'` lines only bring instances into scope, so I did not count them as fragile. The final `simpa only [Path.segment_apply, AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module]` is the one slightly sensitive spot. It depends on the `@[simps]`-generated lemma `Path.segment_apply` and on the form `(1 - c) • p₀ + c • p₁`. Both come from stable Mathlib API, and the proof is two lemmas long, so I could not justify a finding. I did not look at TauCeti.Analysis.Fredholm.SmallPerturbation, which supplies `eventually_isFredholm_and_index_eq`. The proofs only use that lemma through its statement.
